title: Cardplayer
summary: Minimalistic MP3 / Webradio player. Winamp style.
description: Cardputer Player is a compact, Winamp-inspired music player built specifically for the M5Stack CardputerZero’s 320×170 display. It supports MP3, FLAC, and WAV playback, Dutch internet radio, library filtering, PipeWire audio output selection, persistent color themes, and interactive spectrum visualizations. It integrates with the CardputerZero APPLaunch launcher and includes Docker-based ARM64 builds plus Debian package support.
